lessons: A completed-day pattern and a current entry are different observations. MSFT retained its Friday technical label but Monday prices exceeded the allowed chase ceiling.
An inexpensive spread is only one requirement. All five recorded spreads passed, while benchmark or trigger conditions still rejected the candidates.
A positive relative return does not guarantee a setup. Ethereum outperformed Bitcoin over 20 days but failed to reclaim the previous-day high, leaving no current plan.
ETFs have no single company earnings date, yet component earnings and central-bank announcements can materially affect them. An ETF exemption does not mean an event-free holding period.
A plausible news explanation for a price gap is not the same as reconciling split-adjusted history. Keep separate evidence requirements separate.
When a prior research lead was never alerted, an ordinary change in its technical status belongs in the log and does not warrant a new notification.
An incomplete scheduled attempt is a coverage gap. This record preserves the later actual observations instead of inventing prices for the earlier checkpoint.

entries.summary: Expanded coverage from 34 to 60 stocks and ETFs, with separate Bitcoin and Ethereum research; three equity patterns and one crypto pattern appeared, with no qualified opportunity.
entries.data_freshness: Manual expansion review requested on September 12, not a scheduled weekend check. Equity data was downloaded at 20:57:34 UTC: 302 completed regular sessions per symbol through September 11, with a refreshed exchange calendar and independent September 11 SIP close comparison. Crypto uses 300 completed UTC days through September 11, fetched at 21:02:44 UTC; its report was generated at 2026-09-12T21:03:41.147479+00:00. The recorded Alpaca US quotes were fresh at that report generation, but were not refreshed during this later write-up and are not Robinhood execution quotes. No current regular-session equity quotes or fresh issuer earnings/news clearance were obtained. Old baseline evidence remains unchanged.
observations: Coverage is now 47 stocks and 13 ETFs. The 26 additions span technology, financials, industrials, energy, healthcare and consumer businesses; inclusion is permission to research, not an endorsement.

All 60 equity histories contain 302 matching completed exchange sessions. Their September 11 closes agree with a separate Alpaca SIP daily-bar comparison within one cent. Histories were requested with split adjustment; provider share-volume consolidation remains unspecified.

Robinhood quote close fields returned September 10 timestamps, so they were not mislabeled as September 11 official closes. The separate SIP comparison was used only for the latest day; its adjustment mode is unspecified and no histories were spliced.

The broad equity trend gate passes on the September 11 completed session. XLK and MSFT remain pullback patterns; newly added DELL has a volume-supported breakout but fails the stop-distance rule and needs an abnormal-gap check.

Bitcoin and Ethereum are researched separately using completed UTC days and BTC/USD as the benchmark. The Bitcoin trend gate passes; Ethereum has a preliminary pullback pattern. Venue-specific volume and quotes cannot establish consolidated liquidity or Robinhood executable prices.
The pattern does not mean the trigger has been reached or that the arithmetic target is attainable.
Stock and crypto exposure, planned losses and weekly entries use one shared budget. No qualified opportunity or executable crypto size was established.
lessons: A larger universe produced an additional technical pattern, not an additional qualified opportunity. More symbols broaden the search without increasing the weekly trade quota.
A breakout can pass momentum and volume tests but still fail risk rules. DELL's 11.42% stop distance exceeds the equity limit even though relative volume is 1.70 times average.
An unusual overnight move is a reason to investigate, not proof of a split. Keep unresolved data quality flags visible until the evidence explains them.
Crypto relative strength uses Bitcoin over matching UTC days. Ethereum's +3.64 percentage-point advantage over Bitcoin cannot be compared directly with an equity's advantage over SPY.
Narrow quotes at one crypto venue do not prove fillable size, worldwide liquidity or the price available at Robinhood. Quote timestamps and venue labels matter.
